objective: Test whether the c1g router's heldout failure is caused by the full runtime transcript rather than absent capability matching by screening the same frozen candidate through a routing-only scaffold matched to its training interface.

causal_basis.finding: Balanced outcome updates achieved strong sampled rewards, but the full-context heldout screen scored 4/10 root and 2/4 manager with zero generic and source root correctness. Training requests were approximately 244 tokens while heldout requests included the full coordinator runtime transcript.

preserved: registry order and causal identity permutation
compact_router_scaffold.output_contract: exactly one JSON object with one string field named expert_id

decision_rule.if_screen_passes: Retain c1g as an isolated router candidate and implement the compact projection in the live split scaffold before an end-to-end population evaluation.
decision_rule.if_screen_fails: Reject c1g and use the observed errors to design a prospective harness-shaped training rung; do not update weights automatically.
decision_rule.promotion_requires: A later live end-to-end population evaluation with at least four complete qualifying trajectories.
